senses.gloss:
पैशल्य पैशल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पेशल), kind-
liness, graciousness, affability, mildness.

पैशाच पैशाच, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or be-
longing to a Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal,
demoniacal; पैशाचो ग्रहः, demoniacal possession;
(अस्), m. the eighth and lowest from of marriage, one
of the eight forms of marriage according to Manu
(described in Manu III. 34 as taking place when a
lover secretly embraces a damsel either sleeping or
intoxicated or disordered in her intellect); a Piśāca
or kind of demon; (ई), f. a present made at a
religious ceremony to secure friendly regard; a sort
of gibberish spoken by demons on the stage [cf. पि-
शाच-भाषा]; night; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

पैशाचिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a
Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal, demoniacal.

पैशुन पैशुन or पैशुन्य, अम्, n. (fr. पि-
शुन), the act of informing or giving information,
tale-bearing, backbiting, calumny, espionage, report-
ing evil of others, malignity, roguery, depravity,
wickedness.

पैष्ट पैष्ट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of
flour, ground or made up into a cake; (ई), f. spirituous
liquor distilled from meal or extracted from bruised
rice.

पैष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of meal
or flour; (अम्), n. a quantity of cakes; spirituous
liquor distilled from meal.
